translations.web: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”
translations.bsb: Each one helps the other and says to his brother, “Be strong!”
translations.kjv: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.
translations.asv: They help every one his neighbor; and every one saith to his brother, Be of good courage.
